text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still-chan, I finally found you! It's your 
birthday today, right? Happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And you see, I heard that you have a sweet 
tooth, Still-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I brought some famous snacks from 
Tomakomai! Want to go eat them together at 
the cafeteria?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
With the sweet and sour taste of haskap 
berries, Still-chan's heart is bound to 
flutter♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how adorable. It's almost like... 
being in love.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Still-chan's smile really is so 
striking it makes your heart skip a beat, 
doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It really catches the eye, or rather... Is 
there some kind of trick to it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"N-No way... umm... well. ...P-Please 
don't stare at me so much..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*Gasp*! Perfect masking of your 
embarrassment... ...I shall steal that 
technique!
